messages:
maria_sales: Quick handoff for NovaThrive (mid-market fintech). Signed yesterday. Asks: Okta SSO, VPC peering in eu-west-1, dedicated capacity ~2k reqs/min, EU data residency. Renewal sensitivity: medium-high if onboarding slips.

liam_cs: Thanks Maria. Priya will own onboarding. Priya, can you confirm the SSO steps and CSM kickoff timing? @ben_support + @devon_eng — please standby for infra & perf needs.

priya_cs: Got it. I'll run the kickoff and collect SP/IDP metadata + network CIDR. Maria, please paste the customer contact and Okta metadata link here.

maria_sales: Contact: sara@novathrive.com. Okta metadata (staging): https://okta.example/metadata/sara. CIDR: 10.8.0.0/16. Kickoff scheduled 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

ben_support: I'm opening INC-6721 for Dedicated capacity + peering. Will attach expected token/throughput numbers. Assigning to infra queue.

devon_eng: For perf: median ~120 tokens, ~10% long reads to 800 tokens. Recommend pre-warm KV cache and test batching; I'll run a sim once Priya shares prompt samples.

sheila_legal: Looping legal: SOC2 addendum requested by customer. I'll triage; could add ~1 week to timeline depending on findings.

liam_cs: Owners & next steps: Priya = onboarding lead (collect metadata EOD), Ben = open infra ticket + attach numbers (EOD), Devon = perf sim (48h), Sheila = SOC2 review. I'll create a dedicated channel after kickoff. Risk note: SSO delay >10 days increases renewal risk. :warning:

onboard-bot: Reminder: kickoff event created for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.

priya_cs: I'll post the prompt set and a simple warmup snippet to INC-6721 after the kickoff. Sample warmup: 200 short generation requests to populate KV cache. Will update once infra ticket is attached. :thumbsup:
